checks.cohort_anchor: Exact hard-pinned subset SHA binds the previously audited ledger SHA, current configuration/selection hashes and eligibility implementation; recomputed two-model membership and original selection-order prefix agree. The actual native-runtime frozen_cohort function passed against the resident uploaded ledger, with 256 planned, 252 joint complete and 128 conditional-subset contexts.
checks.source_and_terminal_binding: Actual read_cell validates uploaded fit files, recipes, identities, coverage and a complete exit0 terminal; the new reader additionally binds terminal cell and result SHA. Actual generation binding ties each fitted native k10 component hash to its canonical-reference raw-generation SHA and recomputes final eligibility. Actual bind_analysis checks uploaded diagnostic marker/input proof, source byte compatibility and exact fitted result/manifest/per-example files; the new reader requires the corresponding successful diagnostic terminal.
checks.mathematics: Native target rows and per-context noise arrays are independently aligned by context ID to the same joint cohort. Numerator is the mean estimated variance trace of each K5 mean; denominator is that target's unbiased between-context variance trace on those rows. J/R component-remainder covariance identities are checked; no predictor performance enters the noise ratio or threshold choice.
checks.decision_semantics: Requires exactly full/J/restJ/R/restR and threshold 0.1. Only a finite nonnegative fraction strictly greater than 0.1 triggers. Zero remains non-triggering; zero observed target variance remains explicitly undefined. A positive result requires the two-model OR follow-up; negative/undefined results always await the other model or final supplement and never announce a globally cleared follow-up.
checks.output_integrity: Fresh output directory required; proof records exact source receipts/files and subset SHA. The selected noise arrays preserve ID alignment; final marker hashes all published decision inputs/outputs. No GPU launch or fitting occurs.

independent_tests.fixture: Actual tiny CPU ridge/MLP producer outputs, actual Source/read_cell/read_arrays/generation-binding/bind_analysis/frozen_cohort/align_arrays/paired_noise/decision_summary and output writer. Only the synthetic config/runtime identity and synthetic subset pin are substituted in local fixtures; real immutable subset/runtime validation is covered separately by the remote preflight.
coverage: Full reader output and selected arrays match independent scalar rollout-noise and target-variance calculations on reordered, reduced common rows.
Target mutation and changed noise bytes reject against producer receipt hashes.
Re-uploaded inconsistent noise covariance, wrong seed roster, changed cohort bytes and reordered pinned subset reject.
Native terminal cell mismatch and diagnostic terminal marker mismatch reject.
None, zero, exact 0.1, nextafter(0.1,1), negative, NaN and infinity receive the expected strict decision or rejection.
Nonbinary constant 0.1 targets retain explicit undefined variance rather than being treated as a zero-noise result.

native_runtime_preflight.operation: Only actual frozen_cohort on the resident completion source; no fit/prediction arrays loaded. Same-byte reader/subset copies lived in an isolated temporary directory outside the clean checkout and were removed on exit.

scope_limits: Approval concerns the reader and its current exact dependencies; no actual model noise decision was evaluated.
A production call requires completed, uploaded native fit and diagnostics artifacts with their matching successful terminals. The native-runtime preflight tested only the cohort gate.

The reader internally verifies saved fit metrics through the existing read_arrays consumer, but the trigger depends only on target variance and rollout noise. It does not tune against prediction errors.
Any later K5-versus-K20 diagnostic must retain frozen predictors and canonical K5 inputs and compare identical realized joint K20-complete rows, as bound by the unchanged subset declaration.
